cases.text: 1. Run Hellcats  from your original unlocked floppy.  Any installation copies made      from your original floppy after this time  will contain your unique serial number.  2. Record your serial number on the registration card provided with the package.  3. Complete the card and mail it.  We will return to you (by mail only) an UNLOCK      CODE.  Any copy of Hellcats  with your serial number can be unlocked by entering      this UNLOCK CODE in the box below.  Note: when entering the UNLOCK CODE, you must      also enter an appropriate word from your manual—but this will be the last time!
